extra.final_summary:
Data quality issues found and fixed:
- Species label variants: adelie, gentoo, chinstrap, Gentto normalized to Adelie, Gentoo, Chinstrap (4 rows)
- body_mass_g stored as text with commas: cast to numeric (rows 9, 24)
- flipper_length_mm out of range: rows 2 (-190) and 50 (-195) excluded per rules (170-235)
- body_mass_g out of range: row 39 value 4,150,000 excluded per rules (2500-6500)

After cleaning, 48 rows remain. Average body mass by species:
- Adelie: 3,701.39 g
- Chinstrap: 3,754.55 g
- Gentoo: 5,081.58 g

Caveats: 3 rows excluded due to invalid measurements; averages reflect cleaned data only.
